voiceScript: Every client site used to start the same way. I'd eyeball the colors and guess a font. Most redesigns stop right there, and they miss the shadow system, the spacing scale, the motion timing. So I built something that reads the site instead. It scanned over two thousand elements in under two minutes and handed me the exact palette, type scale, and shadows as a file. I shipped eight sections in under four hundred lines of new code, for about a quarter in AI cost. Every pattern I solve once carries forward. Site ten ships faster than site two. Follow for more.
